ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels with localized high-intensity (white) pixel disruptions; estimated macro-level ratio of 90:10 dark-to-light pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark low-intensity contiguous mass across both lobes; no large-scale white mottling or geometric blobs; high-intensity pixels are limited to fine-scale linear and circular point-based distributions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a sharp vertex; estimated angle of 40-50 degrees relative to horizontal lobe orientation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the outer two-thirds of both lobes; inner right lobe exhibits a high-amplitude irregular jagged indentation (dip) proximal to the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trailing edge curvature tapering to acute, slightly upward-curved terminal tips on both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast circular pixel clusters detected at the terminal tips and intermittently along the trailing edge boundary.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of unaligned, multi-directional white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) spanning the ventral surface of both lobes, most prominent on the outer right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular notch/indentation on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe, deviating from the standard serration frequency.
